_doc: Big Five personalities (docs/AGENT_FRAMEWORK.md section 1, campussim/personality.py). mode 'off' keeps the per-archetype trait Betas in population.json (and run ids); 'big_five' draws openness..neuroticism per agent from Beta(mean * concentration, (1 - mean) * concentration) and derives compliance, mask_propensity, honesty, the sick response and social_scale (multiplier on party/event/hangout rates) from them. Archetype means of the derived traits equal today's. weights: logit (or log-prob / log) change per unit of (score - archetype mean); placeholders until calibration.
